scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “L1 Embeddings of Graphs of Bounded Treewidth” (preprints/L1-Embeddings-of-Graphs-of-Bounded-Treewidth-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13276d0ab77859c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer k ≥ 2 there is a finite constant Ck ≥ 1 with the following property. If a finite connected graph G = (V, E) admits a tree decomposition with bags of size at most k, then, for every edge-length function ℓ : E → (0, ∞), there is a map F from V into a real L1 space such that dG,ℓ(u, v) ≤ ∥F(u) − F(v)∥1 ≤ Ck dG,ℓ(u, v) (u, v ∈ V ). (1.1) The constant is independent of the number of vertices, the depth of the decomposition, and all ratios of edge lengths.
